thesis: PLMR is a good business bought at the wrong time. It is overbought (RSI14 74.1), 8% above its SMA20 and 0.9% under the 52-week high, and it has already run +25.5% in 21 days. Price is within 2.5% of the thin 6-opinion consensus target, so the fundamental upside is mostly spent while valuation is only fair. Volume has faded to about the 258k average after the breakout, and the session is a thin half day. All of this sits in a risk-off tape (QQQ below the 50- and 200-day averages, VIX at the 0.90 percentile) where high-beta winners get sold for liquidity. The stock is a clean pullback candidate, not a buy at 167.74. Any fill at the top of the entry zone cuts reward/risk toward 1.5, and a gap-fill to the 154.61 swing low would erase the whole post-earnings breakout.
